detail:
New decision "Envelope and lifecycle payloads are STRICT (unknown keys rejected) while created-record bodies pass unknown fields through; unknown kinds and newer envelope versions are distinct rejection codes so ingest can quarantine rather than half-apply" relates to:
- 01M2KCECC0ZY7SQHV70CG2ANYQ: "Evidence class is decided by the INGRESS that produced the event (ceremony/adapter/connector/mcp/cli/import/migration), validated before storage, never taken from a caller field; human_ruling is producible only by the signing ceremony or an import carrying a valid signature by a known HUMAN key"
- 01M2KCECHHYB9Z6EK9S5HYSS7V: "Canonical form for digests is compact JSON with recursively sorted keys, arrays in order, undefined dropped, UTF-8, no Unicode normalization; the digest covers the envelope minus digest and sig and is recomputed from the PARSED object so on-disk pretty-printing never matters; file bytes, canonical bytes and attachment source bytes are three distinct hashes"
- 01M2KCECVGZRKY3XYPK0G2PDMK: "Two scope operations, deliberately distinct: scopeMatches (retrieval; bidirectional on path at segment boundaries, exact on tenant/repo/task/attempt/consumer, global events match any repo) and scopeGoverns (authority; unidirectional, a rule must name a repo or be global, revision-bound rules govern only their exact head)"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 3 existing decision(s) overlap
